subject: Mutual Action Plan: AWS Marketplace listing for Nova Health — stakeholder intros & timeline
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patil <samir.patil@amazon.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@novasystems.com>; Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nova-health.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-01-09 09:12 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: AWS Marketplace listing for Nova Health — stakeholder intros & timeline

Hi all —

Thanks for making time to move this to a formal plan. Per our conversations last month, Nova Health is planning to list our managed inference offering in the AWS Marketplace under their procurement program and needs a short evaluation and procurement timeline to close onboarding by the end of Q1.

This thread is to:
- Introduce the core stakeholders on both sides
- Share a concise mutual action plan (MAP) draft for review
- Pick a date for a 30–45m alignment call to finalize the evaluation checklist and contract milestones

Quick roles (please correct/add):
- Redwood: Olga Petrov (partner liaison, listing requirements), Rafael Mendes (solutions / technical lead), Aisha Rahman (commercial / contracts)
- AWS: Samir Patil (Marketplace partner manager)
- Nova Health: Emily Chen (procurement lead), Priya Nair (integration manager / vendor contact)

Proposed high-level timeline (draft):
1) Week 0 (this week): Align on MAP and stakeholders; share Marketplace listing requirements doc (attached)
2) Week 1: Redwood provides evaluation AMI/endpoint and test account access; Nova performs quick integration smoke tests
3) Week 2: Security/compliance questionnaire & SOC 2 evidence exchange; procurement solicits internal approvals
4) Week 3: Final commercial redlines and DocuSign; target listing approval

Action items for today: please review the attached spreadsheet (20270109-NovaHealth-MAP-v0.1.xlsx) which maps owners and dates. Can AWS/Novasystems confirm any Marketplace-specific gating items we should add?

I'll propose two time slots for a call in my next message — aiming for tomorrow or Monday PST.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Partner Lead | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments: 20270109-NovaHealth-MAP-v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet - MAP draft), Redwood-Marketplace-Requirements.pdf (PDF - listing checklist)

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: AWS Marketplace listing for Nova Health — stakeholder intros & timeline

Hi Olga — thanks for the clear framing.

A couple of notes from the AWS Marketplace side:
- We generally need the product integration checklist completed (I skimmed the PDF) and a signed EULA/Aggregated Spend policy before approval.
- For urgent Q1 listing, Samir recommends prioritizing: marketplace listing metadata + pricing model + privacy/security page in the listing.
- If Nova wants a private offer flow, we also need the reseller/partner mapping (Priya, can you confirm if you want a private offers path?).

I can attend the alignment call. For gating items I’d add to the MAP:
- Marketplace test listing (internal preview) by Week 2
- Fulfillment & entitlement verification (we can run a short smoke test)

Proposed times: Jan 10 at 10:00am PST or Jan 11 at 09:00am PST. Which works for you all?

Best,
Samir
